SUPPORT US SUPPORT US

Drama
Children have their first experience of the stage in our purpose built theatre as young as four years old, gaining confidence performing in front of their peers and families. We encourage this confidence so by the time they leave Brambletye, they have developed a love for performing publically – arguably one of the most important skills that they can learn.
The children take part in at least one production every year with the top two year groups collaborating to put on a major production. Many children opt to take LAMDA exams and they perform at assemblies, in the Verse Speaking Competition and debating group with lots more informal events such as Boarders’ Got Talent, Boarders’ Cabarets and other entertainment which the children run themselves.
We love Brambletye children because we can ask them to stand up on stage with no preparation. Senior School Head
In March 2009 we became the first school in the world to perform the musical, ‘The Likes of Us’ by Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber. We were honoured to be joined by Sir Tim Rice for one of the evenings and he congratulated the entire cast on the very high standard of performance.
My Prep School Was Heaven.
former pupil 1984-1990, Mail Online, April 2013

Music
Enter the Brambletye Music Department on any given day of the week and you will find it positively buzzing with sound. Each of our practice rooms is usually filled with the music of a pupil having an individual lesson from one of our team of twelve outstanding Visiting Music Teachers and the main Music Classroom is in full-swing with either a class lesson or one of our many ensemble rehearsals. We are lucky enough to have a dedicated, purpose-built department underneath our Theatre to house our many music-making activities, including an orchestra pit to perform live music for shows, as well as many other wonderful resources.
All the children receive a Music lesson from a specialist class Music teacher each week, from Nursery 1 up to Year 8. A large number of pupils opt to receive tuition in at least one instrument, currently including violin, cello, piano, flute, clarinet, saxophone, oboe, bassoon, harp, trumpet, French horn, trombone, guitar, bass guitar, ukulele, voice and drums. As a department we offer a rich and varied programme of ensembles throughout the week, including the Brambletye Symphony Orchestra, String group, Big Band, Beginner Band and three choirs. Regular informal concerts take place, giving individuals, the opportunity to showcase their progress, whether they are new starters on their instruments or Grade 8 musicians. We also have a number of high profile musical events throughout the year, including huge concerts in our Theatre, our annual Christmas Carol service, the House Music Festival, fully-staged musicals and the Pre-Prep Music Extravaganza.
Do come along to one of our concerts or pop in for a visit to see our department in action.
Rachel Selleck, Director of Music
For more information on any aspect of the Music Department at Brambletye, please contact the Director of Music Rachel Selleck on: 01342 321004 ext 245 or email her: rselleck@brambletye.com

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Pre-Prep | Performing Arts & LAMDA | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Performing Arts
Having the confidence to speak in front of an audience are skills for life. In the Pre-Prep, all children are encouraged to participate in class assemblies and concerts, with every child given the opportunity to take part and support their friends along the way.
Pre-Prep pupils also have the chance to enjoy LAMDA lessons, dance performances, and Verse Speaking events, with optional LAMDA and ballet examinations available for those who wish to take them.
A highlight of the year is our Christmas play, held in the Prep School’s purpose-built theatre. With a full-size stage, auditorium seating, and professional theatrical lighting (courtesy of our talented Year 7 & 8 Theatre Lighting Crew), it’s a magical start to the festive season. Parents and grandparents are regularly amazed by the children’s confidence and enthusiasm as they perform—often in front of audiences of over 200 people!
Even our very youngest two-year-olds take part in a special Nativity, making their very first steps into the world of performance truly memorable.
Our Summer Concert brings the year to a joyful close with a vibrant mix of song, dance, and performance, once again on the theatre stage.
Gallery

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Pre-Prep | Inspiring Music & Performance | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Music
All pupils – from Plums Class in Nursery through to Year 2 – enjoy a weekly music lesson taught by a specialist music teacher. Our carefully sequenced music curriculum begins in the Pre-Prep and continues throughout the school, placing musical literacy and singing at its heart.
Many children from Reception to Year 2 also choose to learn a musical instrument. Supported by our outstanding Music Department, pupils have the opportunity to explore a variety of instruments, including the violin, ukulele, and piano; we even have a harpist among our Pre-Prep pupils!
Pre-Prep Music Week is a highlight of the year, celebrating a wide range of musical genres and instruments. Performances by pupils from both Pre-Prep and Prep – and even musical parents – make it a truly joyful and inspiring event.
Music is woven into the fabric of Pre-Prep life, from Harvest Festival to Carols Around the Tree, and culminating in our Summer Concert, where music brings the Pre-Prep community together in celebration.
Gallery

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Pre-Prep | Enriching Clubs & Activities | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Clubs
A wide variety of clubs are offered each term by both members of the Pre-Prep staff and outside professionals to children in all year groups, from our very youngest children upwards.
Clubs offered by members of staff change on a termly basis and are free of charge. These often include a selection of: Nature Club, Art Club, Science Club, Lego Club, Karaoke, Junk Modelling, Cookery, Music & Movement, Chess, Cartoon Drawing, Hamma Beads and Book Club. These change every term to ensure variety is offered to the children.
Others involve outside agencies and do incur a fee that is added to your end of term account. These are: ballet, tennis, football, multisport, cricket, Tri Golf, LAMDA, gymnastics, cheerleading and Mini Notes Music.

Wrap Around Care
We understand the importance of flexible care options for busy families, which is why we offer both Breakfast Club and ‘Stay & Play’ facilities.
Breakfast Club runs from 7:30am each school day, giving children a calm and nourishing start to the day before lessons begin.
After school, our ‘Stay & Play’ service is available from 3:30pm to 6pm. Children can be signed up for all or part of this time, with charges varying accordingly and added to your school account at the end of each term. Sessions are structured to include time for relaxation and free play, with a focus on fun and your child’s wellbeing. A low tea is provided before the end of the school day and children who are booked in for the late session in Stay and Play are given a healthy snack at 5.30pm.
Children attending Pre-Prep Clubs may still enjoy ‘Stay & Play’ either before or after their club.
If you have a Prep School child involved in a sporting event and you would like to be a spectator, your Pre-Prep child is welcome to attend ‘Stay & Play’ until 6pm free of charge to enable you to watch the match.

There are many unknowns about the world that we are preparing them for, however we do know they will need to be creative and resourceful. Our art, music and drama departments are therefore Centres of Excellence giving the children what we believe is one of the most important lifeskills they can learn.

pageCache.pageTitle: Art | Co-educational Day & Boarding School, Sussex | Brambletye
pageCache.text:
Art
The Department has a strong reputation for excellence and our pupils consistently win scholarships to a wide range of Senior Schools. Art and Design/Technology at Brambletye is taught by qualified specialists and practicing artists. All pupils receive a double period of Art and DT weekly and they are taught a diverse range of skills and disciplines that include drawing and painting, printmaking, and three dimensional product design. Pupils are challenged to observe and record information, interpret their own ideas and to use their imagination when making works of art.
In addition to formal lessons, the Department offers evening activities in the Autumn and Spring Terms. For the more committed art student, we offer holiday Art Courses run by the Head of Department, assisted by visiting artists and past students who are currently taking degree courses.
We hold an annual exhibition where every pupil in the school will have a piece of work on display. The Art Auction raises money for our school charity.
Dave Holden Head of Art and Design Technology
In Years 3, 4 and 5 I was so terrible at Art and DT and I also didn’t like it because everyone else was better than me. I could never understand why the pencil would end up smudging. When I was told I was going to be a potential Art Scholar that made me so happy and boosted my confidence a lot! At the beginning of Year 7 I started to be really passionate about Art. I think I loved Art so much because I wasn’t academic or sporty. My confidence increased in Art and that made me better about sport and in the classroom. I am now in the 1st team hockey and netball and I have got GREAT marks in my exams. I have won 2 scholarships. You have pushed me at times but you kept supporting me. Thank you so much you have really made a difference to my life.

pageCache.pageTitle: Design & Technology | Day & Boarding School | Brambletye
pageCache.text:
Design Technology
This is taught by qualified specialists and practicing artists. All pupils receive a double period of Art and DT weekly and they are taught a diverse range of skills and disciplines which include drawing and painting, printmaking, and three dimensional product design. Pupils are challenged to observe and record information, interpret their own ideas and to use their imagination when making works of art.
The department has a strong reputation for excellence and scholarships to a wide range of senior schools are won consistently on an annual basis. We aim to bring out the best in every pupil, and in addition to formal lessons the department offers evening activities in the Autumn and Spring terms. For the more committed art student the opportunity is available for them to attend holiday art courses run by the Head of department, assisted by visiting artists and past students who are currently on degree courses. Pupils are encouraged to develop their ideas using both two and three dimensional media with emphasis on creativity.
We hold two annual exhibitions at The Greenstede Gallery, Chequer Mead in East Grinstead and in our school theatre on Sports and Open day in June where every pupil in the school including the Pre-prep department will have a piece of work on display.
Head of Art and Design Technology

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Nursery | Joy, Discovery & Outdoor Learning | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Nursery Learning
Core Education
A day in the life of a Nursery child is based around safe and secure routines which help the children to feel calm and settled, with time for children to initiate and explore their own interests and passions as well as time for small groups to work with a member of the Nursery team. Our skilled practitioners weave topics which are based on the interests of the children in their groups, whilst introducing new ideas, concepts and the wider world such as global festivals and celebrations. Drawing on key research into early childhood and learning, our children have the freedom to make choices and pursue lines of enquiry, supported by team members who scaffold their learning and enhance the children’s next steps.
The ‘Prime Areas’ of communication and language, physical development and personal, social and emotional development underpin all learning and are supported through play, conversations, games and activities. The subjects of Literacy, Maths, Understanding the World and Expressive Arts are woven around the prime areas, providing a broad and imaginative curriculum.
Specialist Practitioners
We have a wealth of specialist teachers who work with our Nursery children on a weekly basis, teaching PE, music, a modern foreign language and swimming. These greatly enhance the Nursery day and introduce children to teachers they will meet again as they move through the school.
Outdoor Learning
At Brambletye, we live by the old saying that ‘There is no such thing as bad weather, only unsuitable clothing’! With every child kitted out with waterproof trousers, coats and wellies, Nursery can be found having daily time outside enjoying the benefits of their own dedicated play area, as well as making the most of our wonderful 140 acre site for ‘Wilder Learning’ . As well as our School in the Woods Forest School sessions, Nursery children enjoy the flexibility of playing inside and outside morning and afternoon, with our outside areas resourced to promote large scale exploration, development of gross motor skills, connection to nature and freedom to make choices and develop their social world.

pageCache.pageTitle: Headmaster, Will Brooks welcomes you to Brambletye
pageCache.text:
Headmaster’s Welcome
It goes without saying that I’m incredibly honoured to lead this exceptional school, a school that has produced generations of engaging, interesting and successful boys and girls during its 100 year history.
There are three school rules at Brambletye – Work Hard, Play Hard and Be Kind – all three of these qualities can be found in abundance here. Of course any school should be in the business of educating its pupils and I am extremely proud of what our children and staff are able to achieve – our results are outstanding and the scholarship boards speak for themselves. Our pupils go on to all the top Senior Schools and win fistfuls of scholarships in every discipline imaginable – this year saw a record breaking 25 scholarships won including Academic, Art , Music, Sport and Drama. Academic success is of course a priority, but at Brambletye we pride ourselves on educating the whole child. We teach them how to think, not what to learn by allowing them the space and the time to enjoy being children, by creating opportunities for each and every one of them to find what makes them tick, by putting creativity at the heart of all that we do and finally, by instilling in them the qualities of character that will stand the test of time.
At the end of every school year our leavers traditionally put on a show for the staff and pupils. It was during this year’s performance that children showed the qualities I hope any child leaving Brambletye will acquire over their time with us. We saw a great deal of humour, but humour that was in good taste, we saw compassion for one another, we saw creative skill, we saw pupils supporting one another, we saw pupils willing to celebrate each other’s success, we saw pupils unafraid to make mistakes, we saw confidence without a hint of arrogance and, above all else, we saw a group of young adults bonded together by strong friendships created through a very special shared experience – the Brambletye experience!
So, a warm welcome to our website – I very much hope that it will give you a glimpse of our impressive pupils, our stunning site, and our dedicated staff – but more importantly I hope it encourages you to come and see us all in action. My wife, Amelia and I would be delighted to welcome you to Brambletye and so would Hercules, our noisy little dachshund!
Will Brooks Headmaster
What a wonderful rounded school you have created which caters for all sorts of different types of pupils in all sorts of different ways; I think that the values of kindness, respect and manners which Brambletye seems built on are so important in achieving all of this and our children are very lucky to have their school life pinned to these principles; In many ways these are the most important qualities to learn.

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Pre-Prep | Sport & Physical Education | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Sport
Throughout Brambletye, sport and physical activity are considered integral to not only the curriculum but the well-being of every child.
In Reception every child has a weekly session of PE with their class teacher and a music and movement session with our dance teacher. In Years 1 and 2 there is a weekly PE session, which focuses on skill development and a weekly games session which varies between football, hockey, cricket and dance, all with specialist teachers.
All children from Apples Class upwards enjoy a weekly swimming lesson with a specialist swimming instructor.
In addition to these structured lessons, our playtimes provide opportunities to dig, climb trees and the climbing frame, cycle, run, skip and play ball games, as well as be physically active in creating dens, shelters and imaginative constructions on a large scale!

pageCache.pageTitle: Brambletye Nursery | Joy, Discovery & Outdoor Learning | Sussex
pageCache.text:
Nursery Life
Our Nursery Family
Our dedicated team is made up of nursery practitioners who are passionate about nurturing each child’s growth and are experts in child development, with a wealth of early years experience. We work closely with parents, offering an ‘Open Door’ approach to foster strong relationships and support every child’s learning journey. On starting at Brambletye, each child has a dedicated ‘Key Person’ to serve as the first point of contact, carefully monitoring their progress and sharing this with families.
A Nursery Day
7.30-8.15am Breakfast club
8.15am-3.30pm Core Nursery hours
3.30-6pm Stay and Play Wrap Around Care
Our core day includes a morning session and lunchtime, after which children may go home at 12.30pm, or stay on for the afternoon until 3.30pm. We know that in order for children to settle well and get the most out of their Nursery days, a minimum attendance of 2 sessions is needed. Children often increase from this as they move through the Nursery classes, building up to full time before they start in Reception.
Food
Freshly prepared, balanced and nutritious meals are provided each day, carefully tailored to meet all individual allergy and dietary requirements. With thoughtfully designed menus which adhere to strict guidelines for sugar and salt content, we encourage children to explore new flavours and develop confident, adventurous palates during these formative years. Nursery children can enjoy up to three freshly prepared meals a day. Our menus use local, seasonal ingredients that can be sourced as near as possible and traced from farm to fork. The seasonal menus and dishes change regularly, so that children can experience a range of different flavours and cuisines and develop a broader appreciation for food.
Rooms
Children begin their Brambletye journey in “Plums”, joining us at any time during term time once they have turned two. We know the enormous difference that an excellent ratio of staff to children can have and at Brambletye great importance is placed on this, allowing children to have plenty of one to one time with an adult as well as small group time. Children move from Plums Class to Pears Class and finally to our pre-school class, Apples. Our excellent ratios mean that all team members get to know all children, making the transitions between rooms seamless. We offer all children settling in sessions, which are unhurried and allow children to become accustomed to the team and the room they will be joining so that they build excitement for starting.
Our Resources
Our classrooms are carefully designed to promote curiosity and critical thinking in our youngest children. ‘Provocations’ in each room tempt children to explore, think deeply, and extend their learning through open-ended discovery. Each classroom contains a number of these open ended resources, which lend themselves to imaginative play and construction. Whilst a plastic apple in the role play area will always be a plastic apple, wooden blocks can be an apple, a cake, a tower, the beginnings of a road, a person… the list is endless! The imagination that a cardboard box can spark is something we encourage the children to build on in all areas of the classroom.
The Nursery has access to the Prep School’s extensive facilities including a weekly swim in our indoor pool and performances in our 240 seat theatre.
